v0.2.0 — full server lifecycle from an agent: browse the free catalog, provision (USDC via x402 or card, no signup), SSH in with a managed key, run commands (exec), add storage, reboot, diagnostics, extend, destroy.

Initial release of agentmetal skill.

- Provision Linux VPS servers in under 60 seconds by paying USDC over x402—no signup or dashboard required.
- Supports three plans (nano, small, medium) and flexible prepaid leasing from 1 to 30 days.
- Handles payments with an automated two-step HTTP 402 process; supports both crypto wallet and card payments.
- Includes commands for provisioning, extending, checking status, and destroying servers (account/API key required to destroy early).
- Optional account claiming for server management or monthly card billing.
